_doc: Ledger of WebAssembly feature coverage (docs/wasm-features/PLAN.md): parity with the C wasm3 on the pinned test suite, then the same inside EdenSpark. corpus: the pinned suite and converter. reference: what the C wasm3 passes. phases: todo | working | verify | done. parity_changes: commands that left passing.json to match the C wasm3. groups: per-group totals (baseline before F1).

unconverted.reason: wasm-tools 1.260 has no text syntax for the legacy try/catch/delegate/rethrow; exception handling is out of scope (the C wasm3 has none), WABT wast2json --enable-exceptions would convert it if the reference moves

phases.name: P0 pipeline
phases.doc: corpus.sh, groups.json, run.py (--check / --update / --exec / --reference / --parity), the baselines (port 29469, C wasm3 29480 of 65874 runnable commands; 31 s / 11 s on 8 jobs)

phases.name: F1 parity gap 0
phases.doc: gap 20 -> 0: f64 floor / ceil / trunc / nearest of a signalling NaN return it quieted (glibc, the C build's libm); an element segment that leaves table0 empty fails the load with m3Err_mallocFailed as C's _throwifnull (io_module->table0) does

phases.name: F2 port-only passes
phases.doc: 5 assert_invalid of br_table (1287, 1404) and local_tee (384, 417, 505) the port rejects and the C wasm3 accepts: match the C wasm3 or document the difference

phases.name: E1 parity inside the editor
phases.doc: the parity set run in EdenSpark through the guest ABI host, with the editor's float environment; differences to the local run fixed or recorded with their cause

phases.name: E2 arbitrary modules through the ABI
phases.doc: what the C front end links (spectest, libc, WASI) offered to eden_game guests; corpus programs as guests behave as under the C wasm3

groups._doc: run.py totals per group: commands passed, failed, unsupported (a later phase), skipped (text modules). baseline = before F1; latest = the last commit that measured.

parity_changes.why: valid modules whose element segment leaves table0 empty; the C wasm3 refuses them (memory allocation failed, from _throwifnull (io_module->table0)) and the port now does the same (F1)
